filtering_principle: Only images with true spatio-temporal alignment are sent to VLM. Single-parameter trends, bar charts, and non-aligned plots are excluded because VLM cannot extract cross-parameter temporal precedence or synchrony from them.
selection_criteria: MANDATORY: temporal overlays with shared time axis + z-score normalization
MANDATORY: per-group temporal overlays (when product grouping exists)
SUPPLEMENTARY: scatter plots colored by confounder (Simpson Paradox check)
EXCLUDED: bar charts (VLM cannot read numerical values from bars)
EXCLUDED: non-aligned basic charts (no diagnostic insight beyond numbers)
